name: RTSNow
description: RTS-NOW ESP-NOW wire protocol and a reusable 'simple node' helper (announce/heartbeat/settings/friendlyName persistence) shared across every RTS project's node firmware. Canonical source lives here, in RTS-ESPNOW-Gateway - see ../../PROTOCOL.md for the design rationale. Consuming projects pull this in via lib_extra_dirs rather than keeping their own copy.
